extracted.name: Winter spritz
extracted.description: Blend prosecco with cherry liqueur and triple sec for a Christmassy twist on a spritz. Perfect for festive celebrations, garnish with a cherry to serve
ingredient_lines: 1 maraschino cherry plus 1 tsp of the syrup from the jar (or use 1 tsp sugar syrup)
instruction_lines: Drop an ice cube into a champagne flute, then pour in the apéritif, cherry liqueur, triple sec and maraschino cherry syrup.
Top up with prosecco, then garnish with the cherry.
